title: Implementing Cumulative Functions with Generalized Cumulative Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2508.01751v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Modeling scheduling problems with conditional time intervals and cumulative functions has become a common approach when using modern commercial constraint programming solvers. This paradigm enables the modeling of a wide range of scheduling problems, including those involving producers and consumers. However, it is unavailable in existing open-source solvers and practical implementation details remain undocumented. In this work, we present an implementation of this modeling approach using a single, generic global constraint called the Generalized Cumulative. We also introduce a novel timetabling filtering algorithm specifically designed to handle tasks defined on conditional time-intervals. Experimental results demonstrate that this approach, combined with the new filtering algorithm, performs competitively with existing solvers enabling the modeling of producer and consumer scheduling problems and effectively scales to large-scale p

translated_title: 使用广义累积约束实现累积函数
translated_abstract: 在使用现代商业约束规划求解器时，利用条件时间区间和累积函数对调度问题进行建模已成为一种常见方法。这种范式能够对广泛的调度问题进行建模，包括涉及生产者和消费者的问题。然而，这一方法在现有开源求解器中并不可用，其实际实现细节也未见文献记录。在本工作中，我们提出了一种基于单一通用全局约束（称为广义累积约束）来实现这种建模方法的方案。我们还引入了一种新颖的时间表过滤算法，专门用于处理定义在条件时间区间上的任务。实验结果表明，该方法与新的过滤算法相结合，其性能可与现有求解器相媲美，能够对生产者-消费者调度问题进行建模，并能有效扩展到大规模问题。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于单一通用全局约束“广义累积约束”的建模实现方案，并设计了专门处理条件时间区间任务的新型时间表过滤算法，使开源求解器能够以与商业求解器相当的性能对生产者-消费者调度问题建模并有效扩展至大规模场景。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an implementation of cumulative function modeling based on a single generic global constraint called the Generalized Cumulative, together with a novel timetabling filtering algorithm for tasks on conditional time intervals, enabling open-source solvers to model producer-consumer scheduling problems with performance competitive with commercial solvers and effective scalability to large-scale instances.
